_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 $866B-$8A99: the A-button weapon objects, first frame and weapons 1-8 (the Hyper Laser, blades and Eraser follow). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): already initialised?
regions.description: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): type bit 7 set (done before) goes to the per-frame wrapper `$8616`. (`$3C` names the weapon 1-12; names from the manual, see the weapons entry.)

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): set up, and uses left
regions.description: Type |= `$80`, drawing flags `$0620,X` := `$13`; `$3E` (uses left) zero removes the object at once. RUN: `$3E` = 0 removed the object.

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): clear the timer
A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): the Hyper Laser is corridor-only
regions.description: Weapon 9 in the labyrinth (`$30` bit 6 clear) removes the object. RUN: weapon 9 with the bit clear left no object.

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): pay now, sound
regions.description: `$879A[weapon]`: bit 7 set means the weapon is paid for when fired (`$8606`: `$45` chips spent, uses recomputed); the low seven bits are the sound to play. RUN: weapons 5, 6 and 8 (Grenade, Fireball, Repeller) each took 5 chips at once; the others did not.

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): play the sound
regions.description: `JSR $C030` (`$D852`) with the sound id (not played when zero).

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): palette and metasprite
regions.description: `$0560,X` := `$878F[weapon]`, `$0548,X` := `$8784[weapon]`. RUN: all 33 weapon x level combinations (weapons 1-11, levels 1-3) on the labyrinth savestate.

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): the table index
regions.description: Y := 11 x level `$3D` + weapon `$3C`. The four stat tables are read at bases 12 bytes before their data (see the weapon-stat entry), so the real index is 11 x (level - 1) + (weapon - 1).

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): attack
regions.description: `$05A8,X` := the player's attack (`$05A8`); a non-zero entry of the attack-by-level table (`$8701`) replaces it (0 = use the gun's). RUN: all 33 weapon x level combinations (weapons 1-11, levels 1-3) on the labyrinth savestate. 0 mismatches against the tables.

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): lifetime and hit points
regions.description: `$07B8,X` := the lifetime-by-level entry (`$8722`); `$0590,X` (hit points) := the same, or `$FF` (never wears out) when it is 0. RUN: all 33 weapon x level combinations (weapons 1-11, levels 1-3) on the labyrinth savestate.

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): speed class and collision flags
regions.description: `$0698,X` := `$8743` entry (the speed class; also reused as a counter by some weapons), `$0578,X` := `$8764` entry (collision flags). RUN: all 33 weapon x level combinations (weapons 1-11, levels 1-3) on the labyrinth savestate.

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON OBJECT (type 3), first frame (`$866B`): the weapon's own set-up
regions.description: `LDA $3C / JSR $85F4`: the 13-entry table at `$86E7` (index = weapon; 0 removes, 12 is the Eraser).

regions.name: WEAPON 1 MultiBullets, set-up: direction and velocity
regions.description: A := `$0788,X`, the firing direction (0 right, 4 down, 8 left, 12 up); `JSR $C102` (`$F8CE`) turns it into the velocity with the speed class `$0698`; A := 2.

regions.name: Weapons 1 and 6: the strongest level's picture
regions.description: `JSR $8860` with A: levels above A use metasprite `$21`.

regions.name: WEAPONS 1 AND 6, every frame (and 1's first frame)
regions.description: `JSR $87B8` (the animated picture), `JMP $84E1`: move, collide, look at the cell under the hit box and wear out (the gun's tail).

regions.name: Weapons 1, 4, 5, 6, 8: the animated tile base
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` (`$CD7A`) with A = `$80` and Y = 2: the phase `$0638` advances every second frame and wraps 0, 1. If the metasprite is `$1A` the tile base `$06C8,X` := `$87DE[phase]`, else `$87DF[phase]`. RUN: id `$1A` gave tile bases `$76, $78`, id `$21` gave `$78, $7C`.

regions.name: WEAPON 6 Fireball, set-up
regions.description: Direction (`$87E1`), velocity, A := 1 and on to the shared picture / move (`$87AF`).

regions.name: Weapon tile bases by animation phase
regions.description: `76 78 7C`: read at `$87DE + phase` for metasprite `$1A` and `$87DF + phase` for the others (the two reads overlap), phase 0-1.

regions.name: Weapon helper: the firing direction
regions.description: A := `$0788,X`; in a corridor (`$30` bit 6) it is forced to 12 (up) and stored. `$87E4` is the entry used with A already loaded.

regions.name: WEAPON 2 Back Fire, set-up: the two shots go backward
regions.description: Direction (`$87E1`); slot 4 adds 11, slot 3 adds 5, AND `$0F`: the two shots leave 112.5 and 247.5 degrees from the facing, i.e. diagonally backward. RUN: facing 0, 4, 8, 12 gave directions (5, 11), (9, 15), (13, 3), (1, 7) for slots 3 and 4.

regions.name: Weapon 2, every frame
regions.description: `JMP $84E1` (move and collide).

regions.name: WEAPON 3 Wave Attack, set-up: aimed by the D-pad in a corridor
regions.description: In a corridor `$0788,X` := `$8837[$32]` (`$32` is the 3 x 3 pad cell, column x 3 + row): 11 for the left column, 12 for the middle, 13 for the right (up-left, up, up-right). RUN: `$32` = 0..8 gave 11 11 11 12 12 12 13 13 13. In the labyrinth the firing direction is kept (RUN: facing 7 stayed 7).

regions.name: Weapon 3: direction
regions.description: A := `$0788,X` (also the entry from weapon 2).

regions.name: Weapons 2 and 3: velocity and picture
regions.description: `JSR $C102`. Level 3 uses tile base `$76`; levels 1 and 2 take the metasprite from `$8840[direction]` and the palette / flip from `$8850[direction]` (the bolt turns with its direction).

regions.name: Wave Attack direction by pad cell (corridor)
regions.description: `0B 0B 0B 0C 0C 0C 0D 0D 0D`.

regions.name: Wave Attack / Back Fire metasprite by direction
regions.description: 16 ids `2C 2C 2D 2E 2E 2E 2D 2C` (directions 0-7), repeated for 8-15.

regions.name: Wave Attack / Back Fire palette and flip by direction
Weapon helper: the top-level picture
regions.description: `CMP $3D / BCS`: when the weapon's level is above A the metasprite becomes `$21`; RTS.

regions.name: WEAPON 4 Bullet Shield, set-up
regions.description: `$07D0,X` := the speed class `$0698,X` (0 doubles the turning rate), A := 2, picture test `$8860`.

regions.name: WEAPONS 4 AND 8, every frame: position
regions.description: Weapon 4: x, y := the player's (y - 16 in a corridor) so the shield stays on the ship. (Weapon 8 enters at `$8888` and keeps its own flight position.)

regions.name: Weapons 4 and 8: the angle
regions.description: Picture `$87B8`; the angle counter `$07A0,X` is read and incremented; with `$07D0` = 0 it is doubled, AND `$1F` -> Y (32 steps round, or 16 at double rate). Weapon 4 goes to `$88B7`.

regions.name: Weapon 8 (and others): the offset
regions.description: Sine (`$C0F6`) and cosine (`$C0F9`) of Y, each divided by 4 (two arithmetic shifts) -> `$18`, `$19`: a circle of radius 30 px (120 / 4). RUN: weapon 8 offsets spanned -30..30 on both axes.

regions.name: Weapon 4: the offset
regions.description: The same with `$88CF`, which scales by 3/8: radius 45 px (120 x 3 / 8). RUN: offsets -45..45, 32 distinct steps at level 1 (class 1), 16 at level 3 (class 0, doubled).

regions.name: Orbit: collide at the offset
regions.description: `JSR $8908` (move to the offset, draw / test, move back); carry set (the offset would leave the screen) returns, else `JMP $84E7` (the cell test and wear of the gun's tail).

regions.name: Orbit helper: 3/8 of a value
regions.description: A / 2 + A / 4 = 3A/4, then / 2: three eighths, signed.

regions.name: WEAPON 8 Repeller, set-up
regions.description: Direction (`$87E1`), velocity, picture test, `$07D0,X` := `$8904[level]` (1 at level 1, 0 above: the turning rate).

regions.name: Weapon 8, every frame: fly while spinning
regions.description: The metasprite is zeroed for one `JSR $C08D` (move by the velocity without drawing), restored, then on to `$8888`: the weapon flies along its direction while its hit box circles it at radius 30. RUN: offsets as above.

regions.name: Hit at an offset from the object
regions.description: Adds the offset `$19` (x) and `$18` (y) to the object's position with an overflow check (a result that wraps leaves with carry set and the position restored); then `JSR $C090` (`$CBFC`, draw) and `JSR $C0B1` (`$D229`, collide), and restores the position. Carry clear = done.

regions.name: WEAPON 5 Grenade, set-up: the lob
regions.description: The speed class is saved, `$0698` := 2 for the velocity, restored (it becomes the burst's duration); y speed `$05D8` += `$FE` (a kick upward), `$0668` := `$FE`, `$07A0` := 60 (the flight), metasprite `$37`. RUN: y speed -3, timer 60 (59 after one frame).

regions.name: Weapon 5, every frame: in flight
regions.description: A timer of 0 is the burst (`$89AA`). Otherwise `JSR $C09C` (`$CD12`) pulls the y speed toward `$0668`, the timer counts down (at 0 the burst starts), the picture cycles `$89CC[phase]` / `$89D0[phase]`, then the two edge checks `$AF6D` and `$AF57` and `JMP $C08D` (move and draw). RUN: the flight lasts 60 frames at every level.

regions.name: Weapon 5: the burst begins
regions.description: Sound `$42`, tile base `$7C`, metasprite `$21`.

regions.name: Weapon 5: the burst
regions.description: `$0698` (the speed class: 12, 30, 60) counts down to remove the grenade. Each frame the hit box moves to one of a ring of offsets: index = ((`$0698` AND `$89D4[level]`) x 2) + `$89D7[level]` into the pair table `$89DA` (`[x][y]`), then `JMP $88C7`. RUN: the burst lasted 11, 29 and 59 frames at levels 1-3, with 3, 8 and 16 distinct offsets (a triangle of radius about 20 at level 1; rings of 12 and 24 at level 2; the same plus a ring of 48 at level 3). The grenade does not hit anything while it flies, only in the burst.

regions.name: Grenade burst mask by level
regions.description: `03 07 0F` (read at `$89D3 + level`): 4, 8 and 16 steps of the ring.

regions.name: Grenade burst base by level
regions.description: `00 08 08` (read at `$89D6 + level`): the pair index the ring starts at.

regions.name: Grenade burst hit-box offsets: 20 x [x][y]
regions.description: 20 pairs of signed bytes `[x][y]`: pair 0 `(0,0)`, 1 `(0,-20)`, 2 `(-16,8)`, 3 `(16,8)` (level 1: a triangle, the first step no offset); 4-7 `(+-12,+-12)`, 8-11 `(+-24,+-24)` (level 2: two squares of corners); 12-15 `(+-48,0) (0,+-48)`, 16-19 `(+-24,0) (0,+-24)` (level 3 uses pairs 4-19: the same plus two diamonds).

regions.name: WEAPON 7 Area Blaster, set-up: two missiles
regions.description: Slot 4's palette `$0560` := 2; direction and velocity from `$0788`; on to the homing timer at `$8A8C`.

regions.name: Weapon 7, every frame: the turning timer
regions.description: `$0680,X` counts down; non-zero skips the steering.

regions.name: Weapon 7: the other missile's target
regions.description: `Y` := the other missile's slot (3 for slot 4, 4 for slot 3); if that object still is a missile (`$83`) its target `$07A0` becomes `$11`, so the two missiles never choose the same enemy; if it is gone `$11` stays 3 or 4, a slot no enemy has, and nothing is excluded.

regions.name: Weapon 7: where to start looking
regions.description: `$11` := the sibling's target; Y := this missile's current target (0 means start at slot 5); `$10` := Y, the slot at which the search ends.

regions.name: Weapon 7: look for the next enemy
regions.description: From the current target on, slots wrap 23 -> 5. A slot is a candidate when its type has bit 7 set (initialised), is under `$B1` or from `$B6` up (pick-up boxes and screen objects `$31-$35` are not targets), its collision flags `$0578` bit 7 is clear and bit 2 is clear, and it is not the sibling's target. RUN: with enemies in slots 6 and 9, a flagged one in 7, a box in 12 and a flagged one in 14, slot 3 chose 6 and slot 4 chose 9.

regions.name: Weapon 7: nothing found
regions.description: Y := 0 (no target).

regions.name: Weapon 7: aim
regions.description: `JSR $C114` (`$F865`, the aiming routine with the target slot in Y) gives the direction to the target; A - `$0788,X` is the turn needed.

regions.name: Weapon 7: turn one step
regions.description: Equal: no turn. Else the difference AND `$0F`: under 8 turns up by one, over 8 down, exactly 8 (opposite) up for slots under 4 (slot 3) and down for slot 4. RUN: both missiles turned toward their targets one step per period (directions 12 -> 13 -> 14 -> 15 for slot 3, 12 -> 11 -> 10 -> 9 for slot 4).

regions.name: Weapon 7: new velocity
regions.description: Direction AND `$0F`, stored, `JSR $C102`.

regions.name: Weapon 7: reload the turning timer, move
regions.description: `$0680,X` := `$8A96[level]`, then `JMP $87B2` (picture and move). RUN: the turn periods were 8, 4 and 1 frames at levels 1-3.

regions.name: Homing missile turning period by level
regions.description: `08 04 01`, read at `$8A96 + level`.
